recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical cosmic composition featuring a central dark circular void surrounded by intricate purple fractal patterns and glowing stardust. The typography is integrated into the central horizontal axis, using stylized geometric forms that blend with the celestial background.
coreVisualRelationships: Central void acting as a focal point for the main title
Symmetrical fractal structures radiating from the center to the edges
Glow effects on text mirroring the ambient stardust particles
Vertical hierarchy with a small icon at the top and secondary text at the bottom
coreInvariants: Deep violet and black color palette
Soft bokeh and sharp particle effects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Main title centered horizontally and vertically; secondary branding at bottom center; icon at top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central dark circular region containing the main title.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central title, move upward to the icon, then downward to the secondary text, following the vertical axis of symmetry.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black background provides high contrast for the purple fractals and white text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep purple and black for the cosmic background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for the primary and secondary typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Magenta and pink gradients within the central graphic element.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white text and dark background; high saturation in the purple fractal highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid warm colors like orange or yellow
Limit to cool purples, magentas, and blacks

letterConstructionRules: Geometric shapes (circles and straight lines) as the basis for glyphs
High horizontal crossbars on 'A' and 'R' skeletons
characterSpecificRedesigns: The second character is a stylized U-shape with a gradient fill
The 'R' features a detached leg or unique geometric break
The 'A' has a very high horizontal bar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A wide, airy geometric display face paired with a condensed, blocky secondary face.
graphicDevices: Horizontal lines flanking the bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the wide, geometric base for the display text.
Captures the square-geometric feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a symmetrical fractal background in deep purple and black, featuring a central dark circular void and scattered glowing stardust particles.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a wide, white geometric custom font centered in the void. Place a small circular bear-like icon at the top and a condensed blocky name at the bottom flanked by horizontal lines.

verificationChecks: Is the purple color palette consistent throughout the fractals?
Is the main title text wide and monolinear?
Does the central U-shape have a magenta gradient?

postGenerationChecks: Check for symmetrical balance across the vertical axis.
Ensure the white text is legible against the dark background.
Verify the presence of the central gradient element.
Confirm the stardust particles do not obscure the typography.
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical fractal background + central dark void + wide geometric monolinear typography + high-contrast purple/black palette.
